tokens.VOICE_WEDDING: the session still counts when the week is busy and conditions are not perfect.
tokens.VOICE_NEWS_TAKE: Keep showing up with quality and intent. The small gains add up.

news.title: More than 60 chances to train every week

news.take: Elite standards are useful only when they help everyday athletes make real progress.
